config.feeds.description: Feeds shown as platforms on the board: RSS/Atom, or quote JSON for the stock board. Up to five.
config.feeds.id.description: Stable feed id. Also keys the stored token.
config.feeds.name.description: Platform name on the board. Defaults to the feed title.
config.feeds.kind.description: How items are interpreted on the board.
config.feeds.kind.ci: CI build results — Jenkins, Bamboo, TeamCity and similar (failed builds show as cancelled)
config.feeds.enabled.description: Disabled feeds get no platform number.
config.feeds.maxItems.description: Max topics shown for this platform.
config.feeds.keepHours.description: Hours a topic stays after it leaves the feed.
config.feeds.auth.description: Auth method only — the secret itself is stored via the Set Feed Token command, never in settings.
config.mode.description: Board style: split-flap, LED, or stock board. Auto uses flap below 540px and LED at 540px and wider.
config.mode.auto: Automatic by view width (flap below 540px, LED at 540px and wider)
config.ledGlow.description: LED glow (blurred copy under the mask).
config.scrollLongText.description: Scroll (LED) or flip through (flap) long titles instead of truncating them.
